ns2:section.sectionText: Online & Continuing Education (OCE) restrictions and assessments apply, see http://www.oce.illinois.edu. Video lectures, course materials, and a discussion board will be made available online through CITES Wiki. Discussion will take place 12:00 PM - 12:50 PM MWF via online web conference. Students are expected to complete online assignments and examinations on ACE Organic as outlined in the course syllabus. Access instructions for course resources will be sent prior to start date to illinois.edu email addresses only. This section has one or more proctored exams which may carry additional fees. Proctoring options include fee-based ProctorU and approved proctoring centers, and testing facilities located at the Online & Continuing Education offices on the Urbana-Champaign campus, which carry no fees.
ns2:section.sectionNotes: Restricted to NDEG:Grad Nondegree-CE-UIUC or NDEG:Undergrad Nondeg-CE-UIUC.
ns2:section.sectionFeeAmount: OCE Tuition $325.00 per Bill Hour, and OCE Fees $50.00 per Bill Hour.
